image_description: A close-up shot of two golden-brown bagels resting on a wire cooling rack. The foreground bagel is topped with sesame seeds and features a distinct, ornate metallic band or ring wrapped around its lower section. The background bagel is partially visible, also topped with seeds. A blurred package with text is visible in the background.

artifact_observations.location: Lower circumference of the foreground bagel
artifact_observations.reasoning: A complex, ornate metallic lattice/band is fused into the bread. This is a severe structural and semantic hallucination. The metal appears to merge seamlessly with the crust without proper occlusion or physical logic (e.g., crushing the dough).
The yellow text on the white package is illegible and distorted, typical of AI-generated background details failing to render coherent typography.

artifact_observations.location: Interface between metal band and bread
artifact_observations.reasoning: The texture of the bread does not react realistically to the hard metal object; there is no indentation or compression where the tight band meets the soft crust.
